user.title: Map existing equipment sources
user.description: Read-only monitoring of existing Home Assistant entities. No Viessmann credentials or extra API requests. Select the equipment devices first. Flow and mode are required; active diagnosis also needs a pump-running source. This is not a safety device.

data_description.name: A short name for this monitor, such as Demo Guard. Actual entity IDs may differ.
data_description.device_ids: Only enabled sources belonging to these devices can be used.
data_description.flow_entity: A finite, nonnegative number with an explicit supported volumetric unit. Never assume an absent unit.
data_description.mode_entity: Map this entity's raw states to active, idle, or excluded modes in the next step.
data_description.pump_entity: Needed for active flow diagnosis. Leaving it empty makes that diagnosis unavailable.
data_description.pump_speed_entity: Optional numeric percentage from 0 to 100 with unit %. Used to compare similar pump operation.
data_description.fault_entity: Optional. Requires explicit fault and clear values; a native fault does not identify its physical cause.
data_description.supply_temperature_entity: Optional supply-side temperature for report context.
data_description.return_temperature_entity: Optional return-side temperature for report context.
data_description.pressure_entity: Optional circuit pressure for report context, not equipment control.
data_description.outside_temperature_entity: Optional outdoor temperature for report context.
data_description.compressor_entity: Optional compressor telemetry. No compressor command is sent.
data_description.valve_entity: Optional valve telemetry. No valve command is sent.

rules.title: Set evidence and comparison rules
rules.description: Use the installation-specific minimum from reliable equipment documentation or a qualified professional. Software defaults and demo values are not manufacturer limits. Map raw source states, exclude defrost, and keep incompatible categories separate.

data_description.min_flow_l_min: Required installation-specific limit. This project supplies no universal or manufacturer minimum.
data_description.absolute_persistence_s: How long eligible low-flow observations must persist before an urgent incident.
data_description.relative_drop_pct: Decline against a fixed, explicitly confirmed healthy reference in comparable conditions.
data_description.relative_persistence_s: How long a comparable relative decline must persist before a watch incident.
data_description.hysteresis_pct: Recovery margin. Must be smaller than the relative decline threshold.
data_description.recovery_s: Sustained fresh, eligible healthy evidence required for recovery. Maintenance actions do not replace it.
data_description.startup_grace_s: Wait after startup or a change of operating context before evaluating flow.
data_description.stale_after_s: Age of an HA report, not the physical measurement. An unchanged cached state may become stale.
data_description.calibration_samples: Minimum fresh observations after explicit healthy calibration confirmation.
data_description.calibration_duration_s: Minimum observation span for a stable healthy reference. No automatic downward relearning.
data_description.pump_tolerance_pct: Maximum comparable speed difference when an optional percentage speed source is configured.
data_description.running_modes: At least one raw mode value. Unknown and unmapped modes are not healthy evidence.
data_description.idle_modes: Raw modes in which active flow diagnosis is not appropriate.
data_description.excluded_modes: Raw values for defrost and other incomparable operation. Never use these for calibration.
data_description.pump_on_values: Raw values that explicitly confirm the pump is running.
data_description.pump_off_values: Raw values that explicitly confirm the pump is stopped.
data_description.fault_values: Required when a fault source is configured. Must not overlap clear values.
data_description.fault_clear_values: Required when a fault source is configured. Unmapped faults are not treated as clear.

emails.title: Choose native SMTP recipients
emails.description: Configure SMTP and one recipient entity per address in Home Assistant first. Do not copy passwords here. Emails start off, including tests. Disabling cancels pending work but cannot recall an in-flight SMTP message.

data_description.emails_enabled: Same persistent setting as the email switch. Re-enabling requires fresh confirmation of the current incident, not an old backlog.
data_description.recipients: Select up to 20 native SMTP recipient entities. Registry/subentry identity is checked; equivalent aliases cannot always be detected.
data_description.reminder_hours: Reminder interval from 1 to 720 hours. Acknowledgement and snooze do not resolve an incident.
data_description.watch_email: Also notify on a sustained relative-decline watch. Off by default.
data_description.language: Email report language: en for English, fr for French. HA entity labels follow your interface language.

report.title: Review report contents
report.description: Reports use a bounded inventory from the selected devices, not raw diagnostics. Review friendly names and selected values for privacy. Each measurement keeps its own availability, report timestamp, and age.

data_description.report_entities: Explicit inclusions from the selected devices, up to 150. Do not select private identifiers or sensitive free text.
data_description.report_exclude: Remove unwanted inventory items. Explicit diagnostic source mappings remain visible even if also excluded.

error.invalid_device: Select at least one existing equipment device.
error.required_source: Select an entity for this required source.
error.invalid_source: Choose an enabled source on a selected device, in a supported domain, and not from Viessmann Guard.
error.source_unavailable: This source has no usable current state. Restore its reports before selecting it.
error.invalid_flow_unit: Flow must be a finite nonnegative number with a supported explicit volumetric unit.
error.invalid_speed_unit: Pump speed must be a finite number from 0 to 100 with unit %.
error.invalid_measurement_unit: Use a finite value with a supported temperature or pressure unit (no negative pressure).
error.required_modes: Enter at least one raw active-mode value.
error.overlapping_values: These value groups overlap. Use distinct values for incompatible states.
error.required_fault_mapping: Provide both active-fault and clear-fault values for the configured fault source.
error.invalid_hysteresis: Recovery hysteresis must be smaller than the relative decline threshold.
error.invalid_smtp_recipient: Choose an enabled native SMTP notify entity with a valid recipient subentry.
error.too_many_recipients: Select no more than 20 recipient entities.
error.duplicate_recipient: Two selected entities identify the same SMTP recipient. Keep only one.
error.required_recipient: Select at least one valid SMTP recipient before enabling emails.
error.invalid_report_entity: Choose an eligible, non-private entity belonging to a selected device.

init.title: Viessmann Guard options
init.description: Update sources, detection evidence, email permission, or report scope. No option controls the heat pump.

sources.title: Map existing equipment sources
sources.description: Select existing entities on the equipment devices. Active flow diagnosis needs pump-running evidence. No Viessmann credentials or extra API requests.

data_description.name: A short name for this monitor. Actual entity IDs may differ after renaming or because an ID already exists; translated labels do not change the default suffix.
data_description.device_ids: Only enabled sources belonging to these devices can be used.
data_description.flow_entity: A finite, nonnegative number with an explicit supported volumetric unit.
data_description.mode_entity: Raw states must match the configured active, idle, and excluded mode values.
data_description.pump_entity: Needed for active flow diagnosis. Leaving it empty makes that diagnosis unavailable.
data_description.pump_speed_entity: Optional numeric percentage from 0 to 100 with unit %, for comparable pump operation.
data_description.fault_entity: Optional. Configure both fault and clear values in Detection rules.
data_description.supply_temperature_entity: Optional supply-side temperature for report context.
data_description.return_temperature_entity: Optional return-side temperature for report context.
data_description.pressure_entity: Optional circuit pressure for report context.
data_description.outside_temperature_entity: Optional outdoor temperature for report context.
data_description.compressor_entity: Optional compressor telemetry, never a command.
data_description.valve_entity: Optional valve telemetry, never a command.

rules.title: Set evidence and comparison rules
rules.description: Use an installation-specific minimum, not a demo value. Map raw source states and exclude defrost. Unknown, stale, or incomparable observations never prove recovery.

data_description.min_flow_l_min: Obtain this limit from reliable equipment documentation or a qualified professional. No manufacturer minimum is supplied.
data_description.absolute_persistence_s: Required duration of eligible low-flow evidence before an urgent incident.
data_description.relative_drop_pct: Decline against the fixed, explicitly confirmed healthy reference.
data_description.relative_persistence_s: Required duration of comparable decline evidence before a watch incident.
data_description.hysteresis_pct: Recovery margin, smaller than the relative decline threshold.
data_description.recovery_s: Required duration of fresh healthy observations, not time spent offline.
data_description.startup_grace_s: Wait after startup or an operating-context change.
data_description.stale_after_s: HA report age limit, not the controller's physical measurement age. Cached unchanged values can become stale.
data_description.calibration_samples: Minimum fresh observations after explicit healthy calibration confirmation.
data_description.calibration_duration_s: Minimum healthy observation span. The reference does not automatically drift down.
data_description.pump_tolerance_pct: Allowed speed difference in percentage points for comparable operation.
data_description.running_modes: At least one explicit raw active-mode value.
data_description.idle_modes: Raw modes in which active flow diagnosis is paused.
data_description.excluded_modes: Include defrost and other incomparable raw modes. They cannot support calibration.
data_description.pump_on_values: Raw values confirming that the pump is running.
data_description.pump_off_values: Raw values confirming that the pump is stopped.
data_description.fault_values: Explicit active-fault values, required if a fault source is selected.
data_description.fault_clear_values: Explicit clear-fault values, disjoint from active-fault values.

emails.title: Emails and native SMTP recipients
emails.description: Use recipient entities configured in Home Assistant's SMTP UI. No passwords belong here. OFF also blocks tests and pending retries, but cannot recall in-flight SMTP.

data_description.emails_enabled: Shared with the persistent email switch. Re-enable only sends after fresh confirmation of the current incident.
data_description.recipients: Up to 20 validated native SMTP recipients. Domain case is normalized; local-part case is preserved.
data_description.reminder_hours: Reminder interval from 1 to 720 hours, subject to acknowledgement and snooze.
data_description.watch_email: Opt in to emails for sustained relative-decline watch incidents.
data_description.language: Report language: en (English) or fr (French), independent of the HA interface language.

report.title: Review report contents
report.description: Keep reports device-scoped and private. No raw diagnostics or arbitrary attributes are included. Review neutral names and per-measurement freshness.

data_description.report_entities: Up to 150 eligible explicit inclusions. Do not include private identifiers or sensitive text.
data_description.report_exclude: Exclude unwanted inventory items. Explicit diagnostic source mappings remain visible.

state.normal: Normal or paused evaluation; check the reason

state.clock_moved_backwards: Clock moved backwards; fresh evidence is required
state.flow_unavailable: Flow report is missing, unavailable, or not usable
state.mode_unavailable: Operating-mode report is missing or not usable
state.pump_unavailable: Pump-running report is missing or not usable
state.pump_speed_unavailable: Pump-speed report is missing or not usable
state.fault_unavailable: Configured fault report is missing or not usable
state.native_fault: An explicitly mapped native fault is active; its cause needs investigation
state.fault_unmapped: Fault state does not match an explicit fault or clear value
state.pump_not_configured: No pump-running source is configured; active diagnosis is unavailable
state.mode_idle: Equipment is in an explicitly mapped idle mode
state.mode_excluded: Mode is excluded, such as defrost; diagnosis is paused
state.mode_unmapped: Operating mode is not explicitly mapped
state.pump_off: Pump is stopped; active flow diagnosis is paused
state.pump_unmapped: Pump state is neither explicitly running nor stopped
state.pump_speed_invalid: Pump speed or its percentage unit is invalid
state.flow_out_of_order: Flow report arrived out of timestamp order
state.flow_changed_without_report: Flow changed without a new report timestamp
state.flow_invalid: Flow value or its volumetric unit is invalid
state.awaiting_post_restart_reports: Waiting for fresh reports after restart
state.startup_grace: Waiting for stable circulation after startup or a context change
state.absolute_low_flow: Sustained flow below the configured installation minimum
state.relative_flow_decline: Sustained decline against the confirmed healthy reference
state.baseline_context_mismatch: Mode or pump speed is not comparable with the fixed reference
state.recovery_pending: Healthy evidence is accumulating; recovery is not yet confirmed
state.recovery_hysteresis: Flow has not cleared the recovery margin
state.calibration_sampling: Collecting eligible samples after healthy calibration confirmation
state.calibration_complete: Healthy calibration completed; fixed reference accepted
state.calibration_cancelled_by_cleaning: Cleaning canceled unfinished calibration; confirm healthy operation again to restart it
state.absolute_low_pending: Flow is below the minimum but persistence is not yet met
state.relative_decline_pending: Relative decline has not yet met its persistence duration
state.baseline_unconfirmed: No confirmed healthy reference; absolute monitoring can still operate
state.healthy: Comparable measurements meet the configured healthy criteria

state.accepted: SMTP action completed, inbox delivery unconfirmed
state.storage_error: Storage error; delivery cannot be safely recorded

state.accepted: SMTP action completed, inbox delivery unconfirmed

entry_unavailable.message: This Viessmann Guard monitor is not loaded. Load the integration before using this action.

emails_disabled.message: Emails are disabled, including tests. Enable emails deliberately before requesting a test.

required_recipient.message: Select at least one valid native SMTP recipient before enabling or testing emails.

invalid_smtp_recipient.message: A selected recipient is not an enabled native SMTP entity with a valid recipient subentry.

too_many_recipients.message: Select no more than 20 SMTP recipient entities.

duplicate_recipient.message: Two selected entities identify the same SMTP recipient. Keep only one.

smtp_error.message: The SMTP action failed for at least one recipient. Review individual outcomes; do not assume successful recipients need another send.

confirmation_required.message: Healthy calibration requires confirmed: true after independently checking that operation is healthy and comparable.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge incident
acknowledge.description: Mark the current incident as seen. This does not resolve it or control the heat pump.

snooze.name: Snooze notifications
snooze.description: Temporarily pause notifications. Expiry is not recovery and does not change the reference.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Snooze duration from 1 to 168 hours. The dashboard button uses 24 hours.

record_cleaning.name: Record completed cleaning
record_cleaning.description: Record a maintenance date and cancel incomplete calibration. This does not prove recovery, clear an incident, or replace the accepted baseline.

confirm_calibration.name: Confirm healthy calibration
confirm_calibration.description: Explicitly authorize a fixed reference from subsequent healthy, fresh, comparable observations. Do not confirm merely because cleaning was recorded.

confirmed.name: Healthy operation confirmed
confirmed.description: Must be true. Confirm independently that the equipment is healthy and operating in comparable conditions.

test_email.name: Send test email
test_email.description: Request a test for configured recipients. Emails must be enabled. SMTP completion does not guarantee inbox delivery.
